newsitem.title: ITALY: TIM shares rise after analysts meeting.
newsitem.headline: TIM shares rise after analysts meeting.

text.p: Shares in Italy's mobile phone group Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) on Tuesday rose strongly after a positive analysts meeting late yesterday in Milan and some switching from other telecoms stocks, dealers said.

They pointed out that TIM, Europe's biggest mobile phone company, was gaining from Monday's upbeat presentation and ahead of another analysts' meeting in London later today. At 1225 GMT, TIM shares were up 2.82 percent at 4,270 lire.
Other dealers said there had been switching out of STET and Telecom Italia into TIM shares. STET and Telecom Italia are due to merge and be privatised this year.
STET shares were off 3.93 percent at 7,170 lire and Telecom Italia was 2.68 percent lower at 4,060 lire.
